rootCauseSummary: PresentXExporter previously returned raw XML text for PPTX export instead of a compliant OpenXML binary ZIP archive package (.pptx), causing PowerPoint to reject the file. Furthermore, brief title extraction failed to strip user command prefixes.
resolution: Implemented JSZip-based OpenXML PPTX binary packager with full theme, slides, speaker notes, and shapes. Enhanced deriveTitle regex for clean executive title extraction.
